# fmc_device_ddns (Data Source)

This data source reads the Device DDNS.

The following restrictions apply:
  - Minimum FMC version: `7.4`

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "fmc_device_ddns" "example" {
  id        = "76d24097-41c4-4558-a4d0-a8c07ac08470"
  device_id = "76d24097-41c4-4558-a4d0-a8c07ac08470"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device_id` (String) Id of the parent device.
- `id` (String) Id of the object

### Optional

- `domain` (String) Name of the FMC domain

### Read-Only

- `ddns_interface_settings` (Attributes List) List of per-interface DDNS settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ddns_interface_settings))
- `ddns_update_methods` (Attributes List) List of DDNS update methods. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ddns_update_methods))
- `dhcp_client_broadcast` (Boolean) Request that the DHCP server broadcast the DHCP reply (DHCP option 1).
- `dhcp_client_id_interfaces` (Attributes List) List of interfaces on which the DHCP client sets the client identifier. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dhcp_client_id_interfaces))
- `dhcp_client_request_override` (Boolean) Override the update actions requested by the DHCP client.
- `dhcp_client_request_type` (String) Determine which records you want the DHCP server to update.
- `dynamic_dns_update` (String) Which DNS RRs you want the DHCP server to update.
- `type` (String) Type of the object; this value is always 'DDNSSetting'.

<a id="nestedatt--ddns_interface_settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ddns_interface_settings`

Read-Only:

- `dhcp_client_request_override` (Boolean) Override the DDNS updates that the DHCP client requests the DHCP server to perform.
- `dhcp_client_request_type` (String) How the DHCP client requests the DHCP server to perform DNS updates.
- `dynamic_dns_update` (String) DNS records that the DDNS method updates.
- `hostname` (String) Set hostname for the interface.
- `interface_id` (String) Id of the interface. Id, name, and type must all be specified together.
- `interface_name` (String) Name of the interface. Id, name, and type must all be specified together.
- `interface_type` (String) Type of the interface. Id, name, and type must all be specified together.
- `method_name` (String) Name of the DDNS update method (from `update_methods`) applied to the interface.


<a id="nestedatt--ddns_update_methods"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ddns_update_methods`

Read-Only:

- `method` (String) DDNS update method type.
- `name` (String) Name of the DDNS update method.
- `update_interval_day` (Number) Update interval day portion.
- `update_interval_hour` (Number) Update interval hour portion.
- `update_interval_minute` (Number) Update interval minute portion.
- `update_interval_second` (Number) Update interval second portion.
- `update_records` (String) DNS records to update.
- `web_update_type` (String) Addresses to update when `method` is `WEB`.
- `web_url` (String) URL of the web update server, used when `method` is `WEB`. Syntax https://username:password@provider-domain/xyz?hostname=<h>&myip=<a>.


<a id="nestedatt--dhcp_client_id_interfaces"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dhcp_client_id_interfaces`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Id of the interface.
- `name` (String) Name of the interface.
- `type` (String) Type of the interface.
